title: AxolotLazr's 2 Week Phase
description: This modpack aims to make your 2 week Minecraft phase as fun as possible without comprimising core gameplay.
body:
# The core of this project
This modpack aims to make your 2 week phase as fun as possible without comprimising the main gameplay.
The majority of mods in this pack are for quality of life, or to expand certain aspects of the game that aren't fully fleshed out in vanilla Minecraft.

## Playstyles
This modpack provides a variety of different playstyles to go allongside traditional minecraft gameplay, some of which are listed below.
### Farming
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) & 20+ mods which build upon it.
- [RightClickHarvest](https://modrinth.com/mod/rightclickharvest)
- [Serene Seasons](https://modrinth.com/mod/serene-seasons)
### Exploration
- [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)
- [Cozy Cabins and Cottages](https://modrinth.com/mod/cozy-cabins-and-cottages)
- [Village Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/village-taverns)
- [Glimmering Gardens](https://modrinth.com/mod/glimmering-gardens)
- [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones)
### Automation
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) & 8+ other create mods.
